newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's June Treasury account falls 1.47 trln pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's June Treasury account falls 1.47 trln pta.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury's account with the Bank of Spain fell by 1.47 trillion pesetas in June to a total of 2.18 trillion pesetas, the Economy Ministry said.
The account stood at 3.65 trillion pesetas at the end of May.
In June, the Treasury faced the maturity of a special debt for more than 800 billion pesetas (up to 850 billion if some regional debt was included).
The debt was issued in 1991 in order to replace old debt over which the state had no fiscal control.
